Do you want to face new challenges without giving up the stability of a highly experienced technology group? At GMV you have your best chance!
We are expanding our teams in the Aerospace sector to take on projects related to software engineering , particularly in the design and implementation of embedded flight applications, within our division based in Bucharest.
 We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website
 WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?
 As part of our team, you will be part of a multidisciplinary and multinational team , carrying out tasks throughout the entire software engineering lifecycle , from requirements definition and analysis, software design and implementation, to validation and verification processes in projects related to aircraft, launchers or satellites , including integrated flight hardware/software, simulation environments, algorithms and telemetry systems.
A continuous training program in software engineering and space applications will be provided to facilitate ongoing professional development.
 WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?
 For this role, we are seeking engineers in aerospace, telecommunications, software or related fields with proficiency in the C or C++ programming languages . Knowledge of real-time operating systems and embedded software development is required.
We will also value previous experience in the tasks described, software engineering based on European Space Agency (ECSS) standards , modelling, and software and tools based on SVF models/components.
 WHAT DO WE OFFER?
 🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.
 💻 Flexible start and finish times .
🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.
🌍 National and international mobility . Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package .
💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews , flexible compensation and discount on brands.
💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee , physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!
⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com
❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
